findings.fact: 0.1 + 0.2 + 0.3 positions were falsely reported as inconsistent with stock 0.6 because comparison used raw binary floating-point totals.
The modal lacks a bounded full-dialog vertical scroll region, Escape close, focus entry, and focus restoration.

facts: Quantity comparison and display use exact four-decimal integer units.
The R1 floating-point P1 is closed.
P0=0, P1=0, new P2=0; the pre-existing modal lifecycle P2 remains a separately tracked non-blocker.

full_frontend.environment_note: An initial run without TZ=UTC produced two unrelated date-format failures because the host timezone was America/Los_Angeles; the unchanged suite passed under the repository's UTC test convention.

full_backend_integration.command: TZ=UTC NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=<local-test-value> npm run test:node -- --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1
full_backend_integration.note: This run includes the final pending-inbound completion and completed-inbound compensation-boundary fixes; it does not reuse the earlier backend total.

real_page_acceptance.environment: Local frontend and backend with an isolated synthetic SQLite database; no real database or production data was accessed.
verified_facts: The real inventory API returned one batch across 12 positive positions; the modal rendered all 12 rows and an exact 78-unit position total matching stock.
The real inventory API returned a non-batch material across two positive positions; the modal rendered both rows as non-batch managed and an exact total of 10.
At 1280x720 and 390x720, the document had no root horizontal overflow and the long position table scrolled internally.
The browser console had zero errors; only two inherited React Router future warnings were present.

accepted_p2.fact: At 1280x720 the dialog bottom was 830px, and at 390x720 it was 1008px; the footer was below the viewport. Escape did not close the dialog and focus was neither moved into nor restored from it.
accepted_p2.why_not_blocking_issue_57: All position rows, totals, mismatch behavior, and the top close control remained usable. The defect is a cross-cutting modal lifecycle concern outside Issue #57's G1 inventory-truth acceptance criteria and is assigned to a separate P2 non-blocking successor.

zero_stock_boundary.fact: A zero-stock material with no positions was not returned by GET /api/v1/inventory, so the modal's zero-stock empty copy could not be exercised on the real page.
zero_stock_boundary.covered_contract: The supported fail-closed case stock > 0 with positions=[] is covered by the focused component test and renders an explicit unsynchronized-position message.
